introHtml: Spandex medical healthcare items offer the stretch and compression needed for braces, sleeves, and supports. Unlike rigid materials, spandex conforms to the body for a secure fit during recovery or active use. Decorate with custom logos via screen printing or heat transfer to promote your clinic, therapy practice, or wellness brand. These items are popular for physical therapy patients, sports medicine programs, and corporate wellness kits.
